meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用 HyperFrames 开发,需要装组件或开发新组件
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按你的要求运行 hyperframes add/catalog 命令:安装单个或某标签下的全部 blocks/components、把已装块接线到 index.html、读取并修改 hyperframes.json,还能把组件片段合并进合成,或按流程编写新块/组件代码并准备上游 PR。
howto.when: 当你提到安装/卸载 registry 项目(如 hyperframes add 某个名字)、搜索或浏览目录(catalog),或要求把已装块接进 index.html、调整 hyperframes.json 路径时触发。

搜索一下能逐行揭示标题的块

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run hyperframes add/catalog on request: install a single item or all blocks under a tag, wire installed blocks into index.html, read/edit hyperframes.json, merge component snippets into a composition, or author a new block/component and prepare an upstream PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install or remove registry items (e.g. hyperframes add <name>), search or browse the catalog, wire an installed block into index.html, or adjust paths in hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block and output JSON.
Search for a block that reveals a headline line by line.
Wire the grain-overlay component into my composition.
say_en.note: Reads the snippet and merges HTML/CSS/JS
